desc: Introducing the new Smith & Wesson CSX E-series, the next evolution in the CSX line. It boasts an enhanced E-Series trigger with a clean break and reset, extensive grip texture coverage, and a modular grip adapter that converts from micro-compact to compact frame size. This optic-ready pistol is chambered in 9MM, with 12, 15, or 17-round capacity options making it the advanced evolution of a classic platform, perfect for those who demand more from their concealed carry.
